title: Incredible wine experience in Priorat DOQ
text: Being the only participant in this Priorat wine  tour,  I paid an additional surcharge close to 20% to turn it into a private tour which was worth it. My driver and guide, Ali, ensured a comfortable scenic journey to Priorat by taking the coastal route on the way there. I tasted 11 wines in total, including four that were paired with a gourmet lunch and three wines were tasted outdoor with lovely scenic view of vineyards.
